verse.unicode: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥

transliteration.english: salok ||

en.bdb: Shalok:

verse.unicode: ਕਿਆ ਸੁਣੇਦੋ ਕੂੜੁ ਵੰਞਨਿ ਪਵਣ ਝੁਲਾਰਿਆ ॥

transliteration.english: kiaa sunedho kooR va(n)n(j)n pavan jhulaariaa ||

en.bdb: Why do you listen to falsehood? It shall vanish like a gust of wind.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣੀਅਰ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜੋ ਸੁਣੇਦੇ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: naanak suneear te paravaan jo sunedhe sach dhanee ||1||

en.bdb: O Nanak, those ears are acceptable, which listen to the True Master. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਛੰਤੁ ॥

transliteration.english: chha(n)t ||

en.bdb: Chhant:

verse.unicode: ਤਿਨ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: tin ghol ghumaiee jin prabh sravanee suniaa raam ||

en.bdb: I am a sacrifice to those who listen with their ears to the Lord God.

verse.unicode: ਸੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਭਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: se sahaj suhele jin har har rasanaa bhaniaa raam ||

en.bdb: Blissful and comfortable are those, who with their tongues chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verse.unicode: ਸੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਗੁਣਹ ਅਮੋਲੇ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਆਏ ॥

transliteration.english: se sahaj suhele guneh amole jagat udhaaran aae ||

en.bdb: They are naturally embellished, with priceless virtues; they have come to save the world.

verse.unicode: ਭੈ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਣਾ ਕੇਤੇ ਪਾਰਿ ਲਘਾਏ ॥

transliteration.english: bhai bohith saagar prabh charanaa kete paar laghaae ||

en.bdb: God's Feet are the boat, which carries so many across the terrifying world-ocean.

verse.unicode: ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨ ਗਣਿਆ ॥

transliteration.english: jin ka(n)au kirapaa karee merai Thaakur tin kaa lekhaa na ganiaa ||

en.bdb: Those who are blessed with the favor of my Lord and Master, are not asked to render their account.

verse.unicode: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: kahu naanak tis ghol ghumaiee jin prabh sravanee suniaa ||1||

en.bdb: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who listen to God with their ears. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥

transliteration.english: salok ||

en.bdb: Shalok:

verse.unicode: ਲੋਇਣ ਲੋਈ ਡਿਠ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਮੂ ਘਣੀ ॥

transliteration.english: loin loiee ddiTh piaas na bujhai moo ghanee ||

en.bdb: With my eyes, I have seen the Light of the Lord, but my great thirst is not quenched.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਅਖੜੀਆਂ ਬਿਅੰਨਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਡਿਸੰਦੋ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: naanak se akhaReeaa(n) bia(n)n jinee ddisa(n)dho maa piree ||1||

en.bdb: O Nanak, those eyes are different, which behold my Husband Lord. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਛੰਤੁ ॥

transliteration.english: chha(n)t ||

en.bdb: Chhant:

verse.unicode: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: jinee har prabh ddiThaa tin kurabaane raam ||

en.bdb: I am a sacrifice to those who have seen the Lord God.

verse.unicode: ਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: se saachee dharageh bhaane raam ||

en.bdb: In the True Court of the Lord, they are approved.

verse.unicode: ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮਾਨੇ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥

transliteration.english: Thaakur maane se paradhaane har setee ra(n)g raate ||

en.bdb: They are approved by their Lord and Master, and acclaimed as supreme; they are imbued with the Lord's Love.

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਜਾਤੇ ॥

transliteration.english: har raseh aghaae sahaj samaae ghaT ghaT ramieeaa jaate ||

en.bdb: They are satiated with the sublime essence of the Lord, and they merge in celestial peace; in each and every heart, they see the all-pervading Lord.

verse.unicode: ਸੇਈ ਸਜਣ ਸੰਤ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥

transliteration.english: seiee sajan sa(n)t se sukhe'ee Thaakur apane bhaane ||

en.bdb: They alone are the friendly Saints, and they alone are happy, who are pleasing to their Lord and Master.

verse.unicode: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: kahu naanak jin har prabh ddiThaa tin kai sadh kurabaane ||2||

en.bdb: Says Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to those who have seen the Lord God. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥

transliteration.english: salok ||

en.bdb: Shalok:

verse.unicode: ਦੇਹ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਅੰਧ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀਆ ॥

transliteration.english: dheh a(n)dhaaree a(n)dh su(n)n(j)ee naam vihooneeaa ||

en.bdb: The body is blind, totally blind and desolate, without the Naam.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਜੈ ਘਟਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: naanak safal jana(n)m jai ghaT vuThaa sach dhanee ||1||

en.bdb: O Nanak, fruitful is the life of that being, within whose heart the True Lord and Master abides. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਛੰਤੁ ॥

transliteration.english: chha(n)t ||

en.bdb: Chhant:

verse.unicode: ਤਿਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾਂ ਜਿਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: tin kha(n)neeaai va(n)n(j)aa(n) jin meraa har prabh ddeeThaa raam ||

en.bdb: I am cut into pieces as a sacrifice, to those who have seen my Lord God.

verse.unicode: ਜਨ ਚਾਖਿ ਅਘਾਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: jan chaakh aghaane har har a(n)mrit meeThaa raam ||

en.bdb: His humble servants partake of the Sweet Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, and are satiated.

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੂਠਾ ਅਮਿਉ ਵੂਠਾ ਸੁਖ ਭਏ ॥

transliteration.english: har maneh meeThaa prabhoo tooThaa amiau vooThaa sukh bhe ||

en.bdb: The Lord seems sweet to their minds; God is merciful to them, His Ambrosial Nectar rains down upon them, and they are at peace.

verse.unicode: ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸ ਭਰਮ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਪਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਈਸਹ ਜੈ ਜਏ ॥

transliteration.english: dhukh naas bharam binaas tan te jap jagadhees ieeseh jai je ||

en.bdb: Pain is eliminated and doubt is dispelled from the body; chanting the Name of the Lord of the World, their victory is celebrated.

verse.unicode: ਮੋਹ ਰਹਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਥਾਕੇ ਪੰਚ ਤੇ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥

transliteration.english: moh rahat bikaar thaake pa(n)ch te sa(n)g tooTaa ||

en.bdb: They are rid of emotional attachment, their sins are erased, and their association with the five passions is broken off.

verse.unicode: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਵੰਞਾ ਜਿਨ ਘਟਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: kahu naanak tin kha(n)neeaai va(n)n(j)aa jin ghaT meraa har prabh vooThaa ||3||

en.bdb: Says Nanak, I am every bit a sacrifice to those, within whose hearts my Lord God abides. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥

transliteration.english: salok ||

en.bdb: Shalok:

verse.unicode: ਜੋ ਲੋੜੀਦੇ ਰਾਮ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਈ ਕਾਂਢਿਆ ॥

transliteration.english: jo loReedhe raam sevak seiee kaa(n)ddiaa ||

en.bdb: Those who long for the Lord, are said to be His servants.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੇ ਸਤਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: naanak jaane sat saa(n)iee sa(n)t na baaharaa ||1||

en.bdb: Nanak knows this Truth, that the Lord is not different from His Saint. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਛੰਤੁ ॥

transliteration.english: chha(n)t ||

en.bdb: Chhant:

verse.unicode: ਮਿਲਿ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਖਟਾਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: mil jal jaleh khaTaanaa raam ||

en.bdb: As water mixes and blends with water,

verse.unicode: ਸੰਗਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥

transliteration.english: sa(n)g jotee jot milaanaa raam ||

en.bdb: so does one's light mix and blend with the Lord's Light.

verse.unicode: ਸੰਮਾਇ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਰਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਹਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥

transliteration.english: sa(n)mai pooran purakh karate aap aapeh jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Merging with the perfect, all-powerful Creator, one comes to know his own self.

verse.unicode: ਤਹ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥

transliteration.english: teh su(n)n sahaj samaadh laagee ek ek vakhaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Then, he enters the celestial state of absolute Samaadhi, and speaks of the One and Only Lord.

verse.unicode: ਆਪਿ ਗੁਪਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੁ ਵਖਾਨਾ ॥

transliteration.english: aap gupataa aap mukataa aap aap vakhaanaa ||

en.bdb: He Himself is unmanifest, and He Himself is liberated; He Himself speaks of Himself.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਖਟਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥

transliteration.english: naanak bhram bhai gun binaase mil jal jaleh khaTaanaa ||4||2||

en.bdb: O Nanak, doubt, fear and the limitations of the three qualities are dispelled, as one merges into the Lord, like water blending with water. ||4||2||
